text:
arjun: Quick question — sizing Dedicated pools for the new 30B quantized model (int8 + KV cache). Targeting eu-west1 H100s. Want to set concurrency goal ~120 concurrent reqs with 99th latency < 250ms. Who has a sim / rough numbers?
claire: @arjun we ran a brief sim last week on H100-80GB with cutlass kernels. Single GPU sustained ~85 concurrent with p99 ~220ms for 512-token avg. That was with batching enabled.
matt: For int8 we saw ~1.6x throughput vs fp16 in our bench. But depends on kernel (cutlass vs triton) and kv-cache hit rates. If you need 120 conc, plan for ~2 GPUs headroom -> target 3 GPUs per pod?
zoe: FYI we have region capacity constraints in eu-west1 for H100 across Dedicated customers. Might want to mix L40s for baseline and burst to H100. L40 per-GPU qps was ~45 in our test.
arjun: Helpful — can you paste the sim output or command? I want to run with our request distribution (tail-heavy).
claire: pasted sim snippet:```bash
# sim config
model=30b-quant-int8
device=h100-80
concurrency_target=120
p99_slo_ms=250
dist=real_workload_jan
run_sim --batching="adaptive" --kernels=cutlass
```
claire: sim results (summary): ```
GPUs: 3
avg_qps_per_gpu: 48
total_qps: 144
p99_latency_ms: 210
cpu_util: 36%
kv_cache_hit: 62%
```
matt: Based on that, 3 GPUs per pod gives cushion for autoscale margin. If traffic spiky, use pod_count_min=2, pod_count_max=6 and autoscale on p95 latency + queue depth.
arjun: How much headroom should we reserve for rolling upgrades + fallbacks? We don't want customers hitting degraded mode.
zoe: Recommend 25% headroom for rolling + reserve. So pick target capacity that is 25% > steady sim need. If sim says 3 GPUs, reserve 1 extra per pod or allow burst to H100 pool.
matt: Also consider kernel fallback: cutlass is faster but we've seen a regression on very long seqs (>= 2048) where triton is more stable. Add policy: if seq_len>1500 -> route to triton-optimized variant.
arjun: Good call. Any suggestions on autoscale thresholds? p95 or queue depth?
claire: p95 latency is noisy on tails — I prefer a hybrid: p95 latency >180ms for 60s OR queue_depth > 30 -> scale +1 pod. Cooldown 3m.
zoe: And set a separate emergency fallback policy to drop to smaller quantized model (30b-quant-4bit) if p99 > 800ms for 2m. (not ideal but keeps throughput).
arjun: Sounds actionable. I'll draft a capacity proposal: 3 GPUs per pod, min pods 2, max 6, reserve 25% headroom, kernel routing rule (seq>1500 -> triton), autoscale on p95>180ms or queue>30.
ops-bot: Deploy checklist created: https://internal.re/redwood/capacity-checks/1796123456 (added runbook template).
matt: One more — tagging for billing: mark these pods as "dedicated:30b-quant" so finance can track reserved capacity.
arjun: Thanks all. I'll run the sim with our exact workload tomorrow and post numbers. If anyone wants to add their perf traces, paste them here. :thumbsup:
claire: I'll push the extended sim (long-tail samples) and link results here when done.
zoe: I'll validate region availability and propose fallback fleet mix (2x L40 : 1x H100) if quotas are tight.
matt: +1. Also log kernel versions tested so we can repro.```
